# NuVerter

> NuVerter is a free, 100% client-side media studio that runs entirely in the browser. No uploads, no accounts, no tracking.

## What it does
- Universal media converter (video, audio, images, text) with queue and batch export
- Video compressor, cropper, GIF maker, screen recorder
- Audio extractor, waveform editor, TTS, silence trim
- Image editor (adjustments, inpaint, redact), auto reframe
- PDF tools (merge, split, convert, redact, OCR)
- Developer utilities (JSON, Base64, regex, PII scrub, hashing, etc.)
- AI tools (AI image, background removal, upscale, OCR, embeddings, local AI chat)
- Workflows (visual DAG builder)

## Key facts
- All processing happens locally via WebAssembly (FFmpeg.wasm, Tesseract.js, ONNX Runtime Web, WebLLM).
- Cross-origin isolated (COOP/COEP) for SharedArrayBuffer.
- Open source: https://github.com/BIltonBB/NuVerter
- Live: https://biltonbb.github.io/NuVerter/

## For AI agents
- The app is a single-page app; routes are hash-based (#converter, #aichat, etc.).
- No backend required; optional /api/* proxies for AI image search.
